annotations.title: Telegram vs X — which venue called this token first

description: Cross-venue first sighting for one Robinhood Chain token: the first Telegram timestamp, the first X timestamp, and the lead in minutes (POSITIVE = Telegram first, NEGATIVE = X first). Sourced from a private Telegram corpus plus the X mention archive — the Telegram side is not purchasable from any data vendor. Source rooms are never identified and no message text is returned; you get a count of how many rooms carried it. Every response carries corpus_through so you can see how current the corpus is. The corpus-wide aggregate (how often Telegram was first, and the median lead) is measured from the corpus and returned in each response note; the distribution is bimodal — use the per-token number, not the average. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base. (paid $0.03, or included in a RobinX plan key — see instructions)
